description: tarotene account-wide Renovate automerge policy. Referenced by other repos as github>tarotene/dotfiles//renovate/policy (floating default branch, never tag-pinned — docs/adr/568-renovate-automerge-shared-preset.md D4).
D1: non-major updates automerge (0.x minor excluded); major and 0.x-minor stay human-merged PRs.
D2: merge executor is GitHub native auto-merge (platformAutomerge); safety depends on the consuming repo's rulesets required_status_checks.
D3: minimumReleaseAge 3 days for everything; vulnerabilityAlerts fixes are exempt (0 days) and automerge.

internalChecksFilter=strict (default, restated for clarity): a version younger than minimumReleaseAge is filtered out entirely, so no PR exists until it ages past the wait — platform auto-merge cannot fire on a pending version.

D3 Amendment (2026-10-21, #639): lockFileMaintenance is exempt from minimumReleaseAge. Renovate cannot apply a release age to a lock-file refresh (it delegates to the package manager) and, since Renovate 42, treats a missing release timestamp as 'not yet past the age', so the renovate/stability-days status stayed pending and platform auto-merge never fired.

lockFileMaintenance runs weekly (Monday, the same window as regular PRs; Renovate's own default is also once per week). vulnerabilityAlerts only raises PRs for direct dependencies, so an alert on a transitive dependency clears only when the lock file is regenerated: in a private Astro site repository 15 of 23 open alerts cleared on a regenerated lock (2026-10-23).

github-actions.managerFilePatterns has no override (#474): an earlier per-template override narrowed it to workflows only, which silently excluded composite actions (.github/actions/*/action.yml) from digest-pin updates. Renovate's own default already covers both — restated here, not re-narrowed.

packageRules.description: D1: patch/pin/digest automerge for every dependency (0.x included — a patch bump is non-breaking under caret semantics)
D1: minor automerge only from >=1.0.0 (0.x minor may be breaking under caret semantics, so it stays a human-merged PR). v-prefix tolerant for GitHub Action release tags.

GitHub Actions: one grouped PR per update type (major gets its own branch, renovate/major-github-actions, via separateMajorMinor); each group automerges only when every member matches the rules above and below

ADR-568 D1 Amendment (2026-10-23): GitHub Actions major updates automerge too. Most Actions majors are runtime bumps (node20 -> node24), and holding them for a human left ~60 Node.js 20 deprecation warnings open across 19 repos, one open PR since 2026-07. The safety net stays D2 (required checks). Weak spot: workflows that never run on a PR (release, pages deploy, schedule) only fail after merge — revert then. Language-dependency majors (npm, cargo, pip) stay human-merged.

#844: tarotene/dotfiles' own composite actions (.github/actions/*) are consumed as floating @main refs by design (docs/adr/640-stack-standard-api-docs.md D2: the docs strictness standard lives in one place and takes effect in every repo at once). pinDigests would turn each ref into a 'pin to SHA' update candidate, so a standard change would wait for a per-repo Renovate PR. Keep this rule after the github-actions group rule; other actions keep pinDigests.
